questions.question: Which planet is famously known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to the presence of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet, with a mass more than two and a half times that of all other planets combined.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, orbiting it every 88 Earth days.

questions.question: What is the hottest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Venus is the hottest planet because of its dense carbon dioxide atmosphere producing an extreme greenhouse effect.

questions.question: Which planet is surrounded by prominent, visible rings?
questions.question_bn: সুস্পষ্ট ও সুন্দর বলয় দ্বারা বেষ্টিত গ্রহ কোনটি?
questions.explanation: Saturn has the most extensive and visually stunning ring system made of ice and rock particles.
